title: Dallas Let Him Walk… Now He's a Finals MVP 👑 #shorts
description:
Too small. Too slow. A second-round pick, number 33. Dallas let Jalen Brunson go in 2022… and in June 2026 he dropped 45 in Game 5 against the Spurs to win the Knicks their first title since 1973 👑 Unanimous Finals MVP, against the same franchise that beat his dad's Knicks in 1999.

Was letting Brunson go the worst move in Mavs history? 👇

#shorts #jalenbrunson #knicks #nba #nbafinals #basketball #mavericks #underdog #nbahighlights

segments.vo: Dallas let him walk. Four years later, he won New York its first title in fifty-three years.
Jalen Brunson. Too small. Too slow. A second-round pick, number thirty-three.
In twenty twenty-two, he left Dallas for the Knicks.
Then he signed an extension worth way less than he could have gotten. As much as one hundred thirteen million dollars, left on the table.
June twenty twenty-six. The NBA Finals. Against the Spurs. The same team that beat his dad's Knicks in ninety-nine.
Game five. Down double digits again.
Knicks win. First title since nineteen seventy-three. Finals MVP. Every single vote.
Too small? He's the king of New York.
Was letting him go the worst move in Mavs history? Tell me below, and follow for more.
